title: Coproduct preservation for proper étale derived direct image
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $g : Z \to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). On the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(Z_{\Et},A)$ and $D(Y_{\Et},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], the total right derived direct image $Rg_*$ preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts. Its bounded-below restriction is the derived direct image of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

proof.text: Mathlib instances for a proper morphism supply locally finite type, quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness. Apply [lem-fin-finite-type-fibre-dimension-bound] to choose d bounding all fibre dimensions; the compact target hypothesis supplies the required quasi-compactness, including when source or target is empty.

For an A-module sheaf M let F be its underlying abelian sheaf. Every group M(W) is additively torsion by Mathlib IsAddTorsion.module_of_finite, including for the zero ring. Sheaf.IsTorsion.of_forall_isAddTorsion gives local torsion, and [lem-weil-pbc-torsion-sheaf-characterizations] identifies it with [def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf]. Apply [lem-kun-proper-torsion-cd-bound] with d. The comparison [lem-sbc-higher-direct-image-forget-comparison] transfers vanishing in integer degree p to the forgotten module higher image. Faithfulness of sheafCompose reflects the identity-equals-zero criterion, so the module higher image is zero. Finally homologyRightDerivedFunctorPlusObjSingleFunctorIso identifies this object with the classical p-th derived direct image for natural p.

Apply [lem-exc-direct-image-coproducts] with c = 2*d and the vanishing just proved; this supplies arbitrary set-indexed coproduct preservation for unbounded inputs, including the empty family. Apply [src-right-derived-functor-plus-compatibility] to the additive module direct image to obtain the second conjunct. This follows the current blueprint finite-fibre-bound, higher-image-vanishing and finite-acyclic-resolution route: the stalk and finite-type dimension arguments are encapsulated in the proper torsion bound, and the filtered-colimit/direct-sum argument is encapsulated in the existing coproduct criterion.

statement_change.old_statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category and let g : Z → Y be a proper morphism of schemes. Then the total right derived direct image Rg_* on the unbounded derived categories of A-valued sheaves on the small étale sites preserves coproducts of every set-indexed family.
statement_change.what: The retained statement generalized the source lemma from finite commutative module coefficients on Noetherian schemes to an arbitrary Grothendieck abelian coefficient category and arbitrary schemes. The cited blueprint lemma assumes a finite coefficient ring and a proper finite-type morphism between Noetherian schemes, and also identifies the bounded-below restriction with the ordinary derived direct image. The correction restores exactly those hypotheses and clauses.

theorem proper_rightDerivedLowerStar_preservesCoproducts
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {V T : Scheme.{u}} (r : V ⟶ T) [IsProper r]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian V] [CompactSpace V] [IsLocallyNoetherian T] [CompactSpace T] :
    (∀ I : Type w, PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I)
      (rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)) ∧
    Nonempty
      (rightDerivedLowerStarPlus (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r ⋙
          _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ≅
        _root_.DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ rightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) r)
